The structure of Tl4Al2Cu2 (reduced formula Tl2AlCu) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Corner-sharing between Al and Cu tetrahedra and edge-sharing between Al and Tl polyhedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
